k.description: Numerator constant for reciprocal function f(x) = k/x

a.description: Left boundary, strictly positive to avoid singularity at x = 0

b.description: Right boundary; its inclusive minimum is the sampled a value plus 1

constraints: Interval [a, b] is strictly positive, excluding x = 0 division by zero
promptTemplate: Define R as the region bounded above by the graph of f(x) = {k}/x and below by the x-axis over the interval [{a}, {b}]. Find the volume of the solid of revolution formed by revolving R around the y-axis.

canonicalSolution.structure: V = \int_{a}^{b} 2\pi x (k/x) dx = 2\pi k \int_{a}^{b} 1 dx = 2\pi k (b - a)

hints.template: Write the formula for the volume of a cylindrical shell with radius x and height f(x).
The shell volume is given by V = \int_{a}^{b} 2\pi x f(x) dx. Notice that x * ({k}/x) simplifies to the constant {k}.
